intent_en: Compare the total four-tax burden across income groups and its pattern relative to income taxes alone.
narration_support: Add payroll taxes onto this chart and it starts to flatten out. The last type of taxes we're going to look at are the taxes we pay when we buy stuff.
narrative_goal: Show that adding payroll taxes to income, corporate/property, and estate taxes flattens the total tax burden across income groups.
current_model_input: Compare the total four-tax burden across income groups and its pattern relative to income taxes alone.
